purpose: Separate regulator/root transport fitness from insurer/product screening so transport failures are attributable and cannot silently widen selection behavior mid-run.

outcomes.DIRECT_HTTP_AVAILABLE: CaptureEngine accepts the root using static_http.
outcomes.BROWSER_CAPTURE_AVAILABLE: Static HTTP is not accepted, but CaptureEngine accepts the root using playwright_headless or playwright_visible.
outcomes.ALL_ALLOWED_TRANSPORTS_FAILED: None of the preregistered transport strategies yields an accepted capture.

comparability_note: A future experiment that passes via BROWSER_CAPTURE_AVAILABLE operates under a broader preregistered transport capability than Product #9's direct-root observation. This may inform the future experiment but cannot modify or reopen Product #9.
next_gate: Blind metadata-path discovery fitness may run only after root transport fitness passes.
